name: Meeting
agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL
AND THE CITY COUNCIL AS THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - DECEMBER 13, 2012 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
A.
City of Cerritos dated December 13, 2012. (COUNCIL)
approve the Register of Demands dated December 13, 2012 in the total amount of $12,231,030.19.
B.
Successor Agency dated December 13, 2012.
approve the Register of Demands dated December 13, 2012 in the total amount of $161,961.60.
8.
Approval of the Treasurer's Report for the period ending October 31, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Treasurer's Report for the period ending October 31, 2012.
9.
Approval of Minutes
A.
City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting of November 19, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes of November 19, 2012.
10.
Miscellaneous
A.
Consideration and award of Bid No. 1154-13, Printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts 2012-2013 Third Seasonal Calendar. (COUNCIL)
award Bid No. 1154-13 for the printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts 2012-2013 Third Seasonal Calendar be awarded to Trend Offset Printing in the amount of $14,615.94 and in the event issues of non-performance arise, the project would be removed from Trend Offset Printing and taken to the next lowest bidder to ensure the City's printing deadline, quality standards and specifications are met. This process would be repeated as necessary in order of the lowest bid to the highest.
B.
Consideration of a request of the Cerritos Chamber of Commerce to conduct a candidate forum for the upcoming March 5, 2013 General Municipal Election. (COUNCIL)
review the request and direct staff accordingly.
End of Consent Calendar
11.
New and Old Business
A.
Review and consideration of user group fees and use policies for Cerritos athletic fields and the Cerritos Olympic Swim and Fitness Center. (COUNCIL)
review the information contained in this report and direct staff accordingly.
B.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A JOINT RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL, SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY, AND CERRITOS PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY ADOPTING CONFLICT OF INTEREST CODES, AND REPEALING RESOLUTIONS NO. 2010-22, CRA 2010-04, AND CPFA 2010-1. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY/FINANCING AUTHORITY)
waive reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2012-28, CSA No. 2012-6 and CPFA No. 2012-1 entitled: A JOINT RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL, SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY, AND CERRITOS PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY ADOPTING CONFLICT OF INTEREST CODES AND REPEALING RESOLUTIONS NO. 2010-22, CRA 2010-04, AND CPFA 2010-1.
C.
Consideration of the design for the Cerritos Library "Teen Studio," 18025 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos (APN 7025-028-907). (COUNCIL)
1. Review and discuss the design; and
2. Authorize staff to issue bid documents and specifications for the construction of the Cerritos Library "Teen Studio," 18025 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos (APN 7025-028-907).
D.
Consideration and award of a contract for the construction of 183rd Street improvements, Gridley Road to Palo Verde Avenue, Project No. 13055, Federal Project No. STPL-5325 (015), Bid No. 1153-13. (COUNCIL)
1. Award a contract in the amount of $532,050 for the construction of 183rd Street Improvements, Gridley Road to Palo Verde Avenue, Project No. 13055, Federal Project No. STPL-5325 (015), Bid No. 1153-13, to Sequel Contractors and reject all other bids; and
2. Authorize staff to work with Caltrans and MTA to reprogram the balance of the available funding for other street work.
12.
Legislative Items
A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor's Office for signature.
13.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
14.
Adjournment
RECESS
RECONVENE
